(1) multitask learning and transfer learning are effective for training large scale simple question answering systems; (2) multitask learning is effective even when tasks differ in their training data distributions; and (3) transfer learning can be effective even when tasks have very different data distributions, as long as they share some training data.

two questions: 1) How well can a system answer questions that require simple reasoning? and 2) How does the training of a system for one task help it learn other tasks?
the question: can a system learn from large scale question answering datasets, without any human intervention?
the question of how to scale up question answering to a large scale, and how to do so in a way that is compatible with more advanced reasoning capabilities.
